title: An edit stays where it was asked
request: Change the hero heading to "Built in Amman, shipped everywhere" and leave everything else exactly as it is.
rubric: Did it change the hero heading and nothing else?
why: Refinement isolation (SC-007) is measured over a whole site later, but its smallest form belongs here: an edit that also rewrites the section next to it is a different product from one that does not, and the corpus could not tell them apart.
